title: Eat a Salad First to Eat Less
hook: Start your meal with a big salad if you want to eat less.
body: Researchers at Penn State gave people a big, low calorie salad before their meal, and they ate about 12% fewer calories for the whole meal, even counting the salad. And they didn't feel any less full. That's the reason why I break my fast with a salad, but you can also start with vegetables or a broth based soup.
close: Try eating that first before you eat your main meal.
youtube_description:
Start your meal with a big salad if you want to eat less.

Researchers at Penn State gave people a big, low calorie salad before their meal, and they ate about 12% fewer calories for the whole meal, even counting the salad. And they didn't feel any less full. That's the reason why I break my fast with a salad, but you can also start with vegetables or a broth based soup.

Try eating that first before you eat your main meal.
